product_overview: A ticket management web app where users can register, log in, and access a protected workspace to view and create support tickets. The app also includes a dark/light theme toggle for basic UI personalization.
core_goals: Log in to an existing account
Switch between dark and light appearance modes

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Allows a new user to create an account using a name, email, and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill in name, email, and password -> Submit the registration form -> See the app redirect to /tickets
Navigate to /register -> Fill in invalid registration details -> Submit the registration form -> See an error message

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allows an existing user to sign in with email and password credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the app redirect to /tickets
Navigate to /login -> Fill in invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an error message

features.name: Ticket Management
features.description: Lets an authenticated user view their ticket list and create a new support ticket.
user_flows: Navigate to /tickets -> View the existing ticket list -> Open the create ticket dialog -> Fill in title and description -> Submit the ticket form -> See the new ticket appear in the list
Navigate to /tickets -> Refresh the page -> See the protected ticket list load again without leaving the route

features.name: Dark/Light Theme Toggle
features.description: Lets a user switch the interface between dark and light display modes.
user_flows: Navigate to /tickets -> Toggle the theme setting -> See the interface switch between dark and light mode
